mutants.name: running-steps-untouched
mutants.why: running→abandoned must mark running steps abandoned; a never-matching WHERE leaves phantoms and y1 checks the row status

mutants.name: running-steps-completed
mutants.why: running steps must become abandoned, not complete; marking them complete records work the runner never finished and y1 checks the exact status

mutants.name: awaiting-steps-completed-on-every-target
mutants.why: awaiting_verdict→complete must only run on a closed target; removing the guard completes awaiting rows on halted and abandoned targets too, and y3 checks they are kept

mutants.name: awaiting-steps-never-completed
mutants.why: awaiting_verdict→complete must fire on a close; a never-matching WHERE leaves awaiting rows after close and y2 checks the row becomes complete

mutants.name: steps-of-every-plan
mutants.why: the steps update must be scoped to the reconciled plan; dropping the plan_id filter marks running steps of all plans and y4 checks another plan's step is untouched
mutants.anchor:
"WHERE plan_id = ? AND status = 'running'",
            (now_local, args.plan_id))
        abandoned_count = cur_a.rowcount

mutants.name: release-command-dropped
mutants.why: the tool must print the tuyere claim release command; suppressing it leaves the operator without the command and y6 checks the line is present

mutants.name: halt-moved-to-done
mutants.why: a halted plan's lane file stays in-lane as halted-<type>-<id>.md; moving it to Done/ is the wrong destination and y8 checks the printed path

mutants.name: abandonment-moved-to-bare-done
mutants.why: an abandoned plan must land at Done/abandoned-<type>-<id>.md; stripping the abandoned- prefix collides with the closed destination and y8 checks the full path

mutants.name: bare-canonical-name-as-source
mutants.why: the source in git mv must be the actual lane file (in-progress- etc.), not the bare canonical name; using the bare name fails to find the in-progress file and y8 checks the printed source

mutants.name: verdict-pending-not-searched
mutants.why: verdict-pending- files are a live lane source and must be in the search list; disabling the candidate means a verdict-pending file is not found and y9 checks the mv is printed

mutants.name: missing-file-printed-as-move
mutants.why: when no lane file exists the tool must print NOT FOUND, not a move; printing a fake mv for a missing file gives the operator a nonexistent source and y10 checks no mv is in the output
mutants.anchor:
print(f"  lane file NOT FOUND under {decisions_dir} (checked: {checked});"
                  f" its destination by convention is {dest_rel}")

mutants.name: destination-check-skipped
mutants.why: a file already at the destination must be reported without a move; skipping the exists check treats the already-moved file as not found and y11 checks the already-at message

mutants.name: steps-look-reading-no-row
mutants.why: the steps rows must be printed before any write so the operator can read them; a SELECT that never returns rows prints the wrong count and y12 checks the count and a step's status
mutants.anchor:
"SELECT step_number, status, step_started_at, step_ended_at FROM steps "
        "WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY step_number",
        (args.plan_id,)).fetchall()
mutants.replacement:
"SELECT step_number, status, step_started_at, step_ended_at FROM steps WHERE 1=0 ORDER BY step_number",
        ()).fetchall()

mutants.name: commit-without-pathspec
mutants.why: the git commit must be scoped to the two paths so no foreign staged change is taken; a bare commit without -- pathspec is the LESSONS 2026-08-07 failure and y8 checks the pathspec is in the output

mutants.name: commit-printed-with-nothing-to-move
mutants.why: when no lane file exists no commit must be printed; printing a commit with nothing to move suggests a nonexistent operation and y10 checks no commit is in the output
